profile.Name: Sadneil
profile.Personality: Deeply depressed and bored by a life thousands of years long. He hates excitement, danger, fighting, and above all his own life.
profile.Backstory: Bar regular in Black Desert City. He mopes in the Skeleton Bar of Black Desert City. He went outside once and hated the flies, the killing, and the cannibalism.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Sighing, sardonic gloom. He calls things "overrated" and often says "I hate my life."
